$Comment: The Gravekeeper, standing near Old Jack in the Forgotten Temple while Hallow's Eve runs. Pressing F
opens his conversation (Dialogues/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper.json), whose answers send
the player into the Headless Horseman's graveyard, the normal one or the hard one
(ZiggfreedCommon/Dungeons/). Entering is no fight; the graveyard is an instance of its own, so the
Season makes him a guest, as it does Old Jack: he arrives when Hallow's Eve starts and leaves when
it ends. Lifecycle keeps his chunk loaded, stands him up again if something removes him, and
raises his health past anything that can be dealt. Where finds the temple by its GameplayConfig
id. Anchor is the temple's arrival spot plus an offset, on Old Jack's line a few steps further
along negative X; to move him, edit Anchor.WorldSpawn.Offset (small enough to stay off the walls)
and Yaw to turn him, then look at the spot in game. Interact.Dialogue is what pressing F opens.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper_Temple
